_note: Napoleon's side of the release builder (release/core/build_release.py reads this, release/napoleon/components.json and licenses.json). Names, pins and release rules; code lives in release/core.

player_ini._note: The player's ini lists only the keys a player may change. It omits the dev, headless and proof keys and the exe-guard keys; the gate (tests/test_release.py) proves every omitted key's DLL default equals its release value, so omitting is safe. A component's ini_set keys are added and gated like the registry's release values (build_release.value_problems; a dev, proof or test key needs an allowed_dev_keys entry below that cites a decision; the rendered ini is checked again) (the UI scale stop-gap sets dev.file_rules until a DLL job gives it a player key). keep_ids are listed although an omit prefix matches: the J24 shadow keys a player may turn off (their release value differs from the DLL default, so they must be listed). The RmlUi host's ui.* keys are omitted while ui.enabled is 0 in release (J30); J35 lists the ones a player sets when it turns the host on.

release_values._note: Keys that must be 'off' at their release value (false, 0 or empty) and the ones with a required value. Parameters of an off feature (a delay, a folder) are inert and listed in inert_parameters.

allowed_dev_keys.dev.file_rules: D46: the UI scale stop-gap (J66) needs it until core W33 gives it a player key

acceptance._note: J74: a release is built only from a DLL whose build id has this many consecutive acceptance passes (with committed evidence) at the end of the ledger; --allow-dirty skips only this count.

known_limits: Multiplayer is untested: whether the added packs or the proxy change multiplayer matching has not been checked with two machines.

Steam is the only supported install, on NVIDIA graphics cards (D13), in English (D14), on the unmodified Steam build of Napoleon.exe. After a game update the remaster switches itself off until a build for that exe exists.

The UI scale stop-gap ships one fixed factor, 2x, for 3840x2160. Other resolutions are not scaled in this release (1.5x for 2560x1440 is built and seen in game, not shipped), and engine-drawn text, the loading screen and cursors stay at 1x. The Lua pixel fixes (battle radar position, campaign minimap, tooltips, grids: J67) are not yet proven in game, and tooltips and map hover were never seen headless.
Changing the resolution inside the game from 2560x1440 to 3840x2160 can crash the game (engine fact napoleon.crash.res_switch_stack_overflow): set the resolution before you start.
The installer never changes Napoleon.exe. It only adds files; Uninstall.cmd moves them away and checks the game folder against the snapshot taken before the install.
